articleTitle: Implementation of Smart-Contract, Based on Hyperledger Fabric Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Nowadays smart contracts apply in management, bank system, insurance, estate, IoT and others, because they perform credible and trackable irreversible transactions without third parties. The paper presents a solution for creation of a smart contract based on Permission Blockchain, in particular Hyperledger Fabric. The tests are presented with Hyperledger Explorer for Fabric 1.4.x under Linux Ubuntu.

articleTitle: Efficiency of Regenerative Braking in Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Regenerative braking in electric vehicles is studied in the paper. Conditions for regeneration, energy flow during the process and the ways of implementation are discussed. The efficiency of the system comprising of electric motor, power converter and storage elements is estimated.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Energy Efficiency in Smart Homes by Smart Lighting Solutions
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Smart home systems have achieved great popularity in recent years as they increase the comfort and quality of life. Significant developments on Internet of Things have captured the electronic industry and has become one the most important applications of smart home systems. One of the IoT-based systems used in smart homes is smart lighting. Smart lighting is widely used and refers to lighting technology with increased level of functionality such as dimming or on/off control remotely to enhance user comfort and save energy. In this study, the effects of smart LED bulbs used in smart lighting systems on energy efficiency are investigated. Then, power consumption on different colors produced by smart LED bulb is investigated. It is seen that different colors produced by the smart LED bulb have different power consumption. Also, three case studies are considered with a comprehensive comparison between halogen, CFL, LED and smart LED in terms of energy saving. It is seen that smart LED bulb has the lowest energy consumption only when it is dimmed and is remotely controlled.

articleTitle: The Influence of Electromagnetic Fields on Human Brain
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper analyzes the problem about the growing concern regarding the effects of mobile phone radiofrequency (RF) radiation on human brainwave signals using complex techniques to capture these effects such as interviews and analysis of electroencephalography (EEG). While interviewing among 200 participants provide subjective assessments for the health conditions, EEG gives a noninvasive way of measuring the brainwave activity from sensors placed on the scalp of the human head. So, the aim of this paper is to study the effects of RF exposure from mobile phone on human brainwaves, which can provide information about the mental state of the individual.

articleTitle: Optimization of Geographic Information Systems for Forest Fire Risk Assessment
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Forest fires are natural disasters defined as uncontrolled and unrestrained movements of fire across forested areas. They pose a permanent hazard of forest and forested land loss. The increasingly more frequent forest fires are often of great magnitudes, threatening not only forests but also crops, residential areas, and human lives. Forest fire fighting involves three crucial stages: prevention, detection, and extinguishment. This paper discusses the preventive measures against forest fires as well as methods of forest monitoring as a means of preserving forest biodiversity. Using modern information technology, such as geographic information systems (GIS), can improve strategic and tactical planning and actions aimed at fire prevention. The paper showcases the application of selected information system as forest fire protection in Serbia.

articleTitle: Wind Turbine Emulator Based on Small-Scale PMSG by Fuzzy FOC
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents the modeling, simulation, and emulation of a wind turbine system (WTS) using induction motor (IM). The major purpose is to improve the dynamic behavior of the WTS applying a fuzzy field-oriented controller (FFOC). The realization of the control process and the performance of wind turbine are accomplished in detail using MATLAB/Simulink. The achieved simulation results confirm the effectiveness of the utilized control system and the desired performance of the wind turbine emulator (WTE) for giving essential characteristics of the WTS such as rotor speed and electromagnetic torque.

articleTitle: Machine Learning applied to the Design and Analysis of Low Frequency Electromagnetic Devices
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Designing an electrical machine which is part of a system, such as an electric vehicle (EV) powertrain requires considerable performance information early in the process. Often, this information is expensive to acquire using numerical models and existing analytical approaches are insufficient. In this paper, a surrogate model based around a Machine Learning (ML) approach is proposed for fast estimation of device performance during the exploration of the design space to find an initial candidate design.

articleTitle: Oil Spills Detection on Sea Surface by using Sentinel–1 SAR Images
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The present paper describes an algorithm and software application for oil slicks detection on the sea surface by using Sentinel - 1 SAR images. Some experimental results demonstrate application's ability to process SAR images and to detect oil slicks on the sea surface. To validate the detection, official reports, provided by European satellite-based oil spill monitoring service CleanSeaNet have been used.

articleTitle: Model-Based Optimisation of a Buck-Boost DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper presents model-based optimization of a dc-dc buck-boost converter. In most practical cases, electronic power converters are designed based on methodologies that do not take into account the dynamics of the devices. This is done in order to obtain simple dependencies and the ability to quickly evaluate the parameters and basic parameters of the converters. The influence of the dynamics on the operating modes is taken into account using the optimal synthesis of controllers. The aim is to reduce the influence of the parameters of the building blocks on the transient processes in the circuits. An optimization procedure approach is proposed here to refine the values of the circuit elements in the power topology so as to have the best possible dynamics and as little impact as possible on the tolerances of the circuit elements on the output parameters of the devices.

articleTitle: Complementary Analysis of the Degree of Polymerization Based on Chemical Markers 2-Furaldehyde and Methanol Using the Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper proposes the complementary analysis of the degree of polymerization by using 2-furaldehyde (2-FAL) and methanol (CH3OH) as chemical markers. It is presented a complementary method of analyzing the condition of solid insulation in transformers, developed based on the fuzzy logic, using the chemical markers 2-FAL and methanol as analysis tools. These markers are valuable tools for monitoring the aging condition of the solid insulation in transformers; the complementary analysis of these markers allows the assessment of the operating life of transformers. The implementation of the method is achieved by using a system developed in the LabVIEW graphical programming environment, allowing fast and concrete results to be obtained.

articleTitle: Review on Blockchain Applications for Electric Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This article describes some of the current theoretical developments and models based on Blockchain technology, suitable for application in modern electric power systems. Because of their significant advantages over the conventional models currently in use, they have the potential to replace them completely or partially soon. Some of these are decentralized nature, transparency and authenticity of transactions, protection against malicious manipulation of data, etc.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Energy Resources in Bulgaria and Romania
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents an analysis of energy resources in Bulgaria and Romania. The aim of this study is to justify the need for energy mix in the energy system of Romania and Bulgaria. There is a shift from the traditional energy pillars, such as coal-fired power plants, which were the main electricity producer, to an energy sector where hydropower and other renewable energy sources provide the largest part of electricity generation. Romania and Bulgaria cannot cope with a single source of energy to meet their own energy and environmental objectives, and to guarantee sufficient stability and reliability of supply. Therefore, it is clear that the energy mix is necessary. This study can help in developing projects related to the two countries' energy strategy.

articleTitle: Study of Time for Preventive Maintenance of the Electronic Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: One of the important characteristics of reliability of electronic equipment is maintainability, and by definition is required to timely troubleshoot the failures through preventive maintenance. An analysis of maintainability is especially important for the electronic devices of high cost, which are used in complex and uninterruptible processes. For the analysis of the maintainability of the electronic devices it is necessary to define two indicators - the time for preventive maintenance and the interval reliability. There are many methods for determining the time for preventive maintenance. With constant productivity (load) of the used electronic equipment, the definition of the time for preventive maintenance is in relation to the service costs and the productivity program. In most case, the production program is variable, as well as the productivity for a given period of time of the electronic equipment. As a whole, it is associated with different electrical and thermal operating and environment conditions.

articleTitle: Transient Heating of Discharging Li-ion Battery
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Lithium-based batteries operation is related with many safety risks of dangerous flaming, integrity destruction, or even explosion. Battery cell temperature rise is an early and reliable indicator for such irreversible malfunctioning and can be used as a convenient predictor even in initial process stages. Often, accurate heat source location sensing is difficult especially in heavy operational conditions, related to ambient temperature changes, vibrations, relative movements, sudden accelerations, etc. In this paper we propose measurement approach and results for observing transient heating of li-ion battery cell discharge in normal and critical overload conditions. Infrared thermography results are acquired and presented, results are used for heat sources location.

articleTitle: Highlights of renewable energy integration impact : Evolution and perspectives in Romania
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In a continuously developing society, energy represents the key needful factor ensuring its progress. Thus, designing sustainable systems to supply energy requirements in all economy fields is a crucial target nowadays, when reduced environmental impact is imposed. This paper analyzes the CO2 emissions evolution in Romania, in correlation with energy supply structure and consumption trends for the heat and electricity sectors. The European and global trends are depicted to observe the classification of Romania in wider frameworks. It is highlighted that the CO2 emissions at national level (particularly in Romania) show a decreasing slope, as a consequence of high renewable energy contributions in meeting the energy balance. As the generating capacities installed in renewable power plants are extending, the prospects of strong reductions in harmful emissions are therefore feasible.

articleTitle: An Algorithm and Circuits for Active Balancing Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This article studies the influence of simultaneous operation between a converter for charging Li - Ion batteries and a converter for active voltage balancing (active BMS). The voltage equalization system consists of resonant inverters with synchronous voltage doubler rectifier (SVDR) connected to their outputs. This system is applicable for batteries made of either Li - Ion cells or supercapacitor cells. Simulation model has been developed for analysis of the converters. The results are confirmed by an experimental stand.

articleTitle: Data-driven Terminal Voltage Prediction of Li-ion Batteries Under Dynamic Loads
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Extensive investigation and prediction of the effects of dynamic battery loading is key to on-board Battery Management Systems (BMS) of Electric Vehicles (EVs) in order to ensure reliable operation and efficient energy management. In this paper, measurements of WLTP discharge tests at different temperatures are conducted on a Lithium Nickel Manganese Cobalt Oxide (LiNiMnCoO2) cell. Terminal voltage, discharge rate and temperatures at four points are taken into consideration. After, historical measurement data is used to build ensemble of boosted tree models and then predict cell voltage outcome sequence into the future. The efficiency of the performance is compared in case of various measurement sets. The results support the efficiency and applicability of direct multi-step-ahead forecasting strategy with standard Machine Learning techniques in battery SoC prediction.

articleTitle: Data Fusion for IoMT in Shiping
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Combining information from different devices and upgrading it with analysis of the data obtained, both at a particular time and in the development of processes is one of the foundations of personal medicine. It needs to integrate the system for personalized medicine for the crews of ships is unquestionable. The main challenge for such a system is to simultaneously meet all the requirements posed by personal medical systems and the specifics of the ship and the life and work of it.

articleTitle: Protection Regimes and Electrical Quantities in Autotransformer Alternating Voltage Regulators
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper presents an analysis of the protection regimes of an autotransformer alternating voltage regulator with four thyristor switches by using overcurrent protections at the input, at the output of the device and before each of the commutating elements of the regulator. Each commutation element (thyristor switch) of the regulator is also protected by an overvoltage protection, which can be an electronic device or a RC group. The electrical quantities (the input and the output currents and voltages) of the regulator with the considered protections have been determined by using a previously developed Matlab simulation model of the device. The simulation results were experimentally verified and good coincidence was achieved.

articleTitle: Research of Reliability of Power Thyristors Using Methods MIL-HDBK-217F and FIDES
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: There are two main types of power thyristors - rectifier and inverter thyristors used in different power converters: in induction heating technologies, in DC motor drives, for power supplies in different technologies such as anodizing, galvanization, etc. For the estimation reliability of thyristors can be used the following parameters - probability of failures, failure rates and mean time to failures (MTTF). There are several guiding methods for calculating one of the main reliability indicators - failure rate of thyristors. The present paper compares the results and applicability of two methods -MIL-HDBK-217F and FIDES, which over the last years have established themselves as basic methods.

articleTitle: Laboratory Automation System Using IOT Devices
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper describes a Laboratory Automation System using IoT devices. The main hardware modules consist of: ESP8266 micro-controller by Espressif and energy meter HLW8012 by HLW Technology. The communication between the IoT devices uses IEEE 802.11g WiFi network, TCP/IP stack and MQTT protocol. The minimal configuration of the LAS includes one control device called Gateway and one manageable device called Host. The devices can be controlled remotely by user-friendly, simplified web-based interface. The project is published as open source software and hardware.

articleTitle: The Performance of MMC-DSTATCOM under Unbalanced and Faulty Grid Conditions in Low Voltage Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents the investigations of a half bridge sub-module (HBSM) based seven level modular multilevel converter distribution static synchronous compensator (MMCDSTATCOM) performance under the unbalanced and faulty system conditions in low voltage microgrids. The phase shifted carrier PWM (PSC-PWM) method was used with capacitor voltage balancing algorithm as an inner control and the phase angle control algorithm was used as an outer control for MMC-DSTATCOM. The performance of MMC-DSTATCOM is investigated in MATLAB/Simulink for various simulations such as reactive power compensation, unbalanced and faulty grid conditions.

articleTitle: Applicability of Calculation Methods for Single-phase Short Circuit Currents in Grid with Voltage up to 1 kV
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The values of single-phase short-circuit currents are calculated at the designing of power supply systems for selecting the parameters of fusible inserts and settings of circuit breakers. Active resistance of the arc exerts a significant effect on the single-phase short circuit current in the distribution network, especially if the short circuit occurs at the end of the protected line. The article provides a comparison of different methods for accounting of the arc.

Author Keywords: calculation of single-phase short circuit currents
calculation methods for short circuit currents

articleTitle: Improving GPS Positioning of Vehicles in Urban Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this article, we propose an algorithm to improve GPS performance in urban environments in the presence of tall buildings and lack of GPS signals. To test the performance of part of the algorithm, the power shift of GPS signals was examined when driving a car in urban conditions. The goal is to evaluate the parameters of the GPS shadows received by the buildings in order to subsequently use them to increase the accuracy of positioning in urban conditions.

articleTitle: The Application of Partial Discharge Monitoring System for Instrument Transformers: Special Issues
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper describes the results of research and development project, within the framework of which a system of partial discharges monitoring of oil-filled current and voltage transformers was developed and investigated. Physically the monitoring system is based on the electrical method of partial discharges (PD) identification, which presupposes registration of the electrical signals that occur in the PD sensors of the PD registration circuit. Given the suppression of interference, the electrical method is the most sensitive for internal insulation of electrical equipment. The paper also provides an overview of modern PD monitoring approaches and describes the scientific and technical rationale for choosing the most effective PD registration approach. The effectiveness of the considered approaches for solving the problems of high-voltage equipment technical state assessment is also analyzed and reported.

articleTitle: Sensorless Control of PMSM using DTC Strategy Based on Multiple ANN and Load Torque Observer
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: For a Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM), in this article, a sensorless control system is presented, with the speed controller implemented using a Multiple -Artificial Neural Network (M-ANN) and the rotor speed estimated and provided by a Model Reference Adaptive System (MRAS) type observer. The performances of the implemented and proposed sensorless control system of the PMSM are presented in comparison with the classical Direct Torque Control (DTC) system. Depending on the estimated value of the load torque, the corresponding ANN is selected, trained to obtain superior performance as compared to the utilization of the DTC strategy by adjusting the control parameters of the system for the overall range of the reference rotor speed and load torque gradient. The modeling equations of the PMSM operation, the speed, the equations of the load torque and stator resistance observer implementation, the most important blocks and control structures, their parameterizations and some results of the numerical simulations obtained using Matlab/Simulink are herein presented. By using common Simulink and Stateflow blocks, good results are obtained through the numerical simulations and this fact recommends the implementation in embedded systems of the entire proposed control structure of the PMSM.

articleTitle: Modeling the Parameters of a Cascaded Peltier Module using Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The cascaded Peltier modules are used as high efficiency thermoelectric coolers, based on their work on the Peltier effect. However, they can also be used as thermoelectric power generators using the Seebeck effect. The aim of the present paper is to present a model of cascaded Peltier module working in generation mode using a Neural Network. Real experiment has been carried out - a thermoelectric generator was designed and the generated e.m.f. E was determined depending on the temperature difference ΔT applied. The data obtained were used to train the Neural Network and to predict the generated voltage E by the cascaded module.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Step Voltages for Grounding Grids at Lightning Strikes
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Flowing impulse lightning currents in the grounding grids of substations may cause an increase of the possible potentials and step voltages to few tens of kV independently from the grounding resistance. This paper suggests an approach for determination of the permissible step voltages' values in grounding installations under the effect of impulse lightning currents with a certain shape. The allowable body current was determined as an energy limit of 10J was accepted as the lowest determined value by researchers in the literature. Comparison of the obtained maximum step voltages and the values of defined permitted step voltages has been done by using a previously developed by the authors model for simulation the processes in grounding grids when the lightning currents flow in them.

articleTitle: Cyber-Physical-Social Systems for Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The Cyber-Physical-Social space integrates different data originating from physical, cyber and social spaces. The large quantities of data obtained during the capturing of physical phenomena through distributed sensor networks can be subjected to analysis using various techniques. This, in turn, can give opportunity for realization of intelligent applications and services. Such applications rely on the effective monitoring of physical infrastructure and environment and combine the collected data via intelligent cybernetic processes for providing of better services. This is an endeavor to summarize the schematic image of negative and unclear effects of new technology usage consolidated in the Industry 4.0. Deeper understanding of dimensions, application and impacts of technologies under Intelligent Agriculture could be extracted from the results and be used as a framework or starting point.

articleTitle: Comparison of Magnetic Systems with HTS Bulks and HTS Tape for Non-Contact Bearings
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This study is aimed at the applying of 2G HTS tapes in the magnetic system of non-contact bearing. The levitation properties of HTS bulk and HTS tape are measured experimentally. The properties were used for modelling magnetic system with different HTS elements. As a result, force characteristics of magnetic bearing with HTS bulks and HTS tape are obtained and compared.

articleTitle: Extended Analysis for the Static Thermal Response of an Iron-cored Winding at AC Mode of Operation
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Investigation results are presented for determination of the steady state response of an iron-cored winding under AC mode of operation. Both power losses Pw in the copper coil volume and Pc in the ferromagnetic core volume are members of the thermal equivalent scheme. The thermal resistance R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub> between the winding and the core was a special item of the analysis provided. The value of R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub> influence on the steady state temperature rise of the winding and the core is discussed while the ratio between Pw and Pc was varied. Numerical data calculation values are related to a winding, which is part of a standard EI 120x40 transformer type configuration. These data are compared with results obtained experimentally.

articleTitle: Battery Deformation Measurement with DIC Technique
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this paper the deformation of lithium polymer batteries during charging and discharging is measured using a GOM Atos system. The aim of the study is to evaluate the deformation of the cell surface. During the tests, the battery cell is re-digitized after 10% energy input and output. Trend results are recorded and analysed for deformation as a function of charge level. We also determine open circuit voltage and average deformation point relationship. Our study supports that there is a correlation between the deformation data and the charge level.

articleTitle: Generalized Net Model for Dynamic Decision Making and Prognoses
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Generalized nets (GN) are invaluable tools in the effort to universally depict complex systems' adaptive, flexible, structured, and well-established models. Here, GN are used to develop an adaptable decision-making model of dynamic student assessment. The main purpose of the study is to propose a student-based decision-making model that is adaptable to the various newly introduced training courses. Furthermore, the combination of the so far accumulated data from documented processes, along with the usefulness of the developed model, may aid in identifying trends applicable to online education. The data presented in this paper is based on studies, experiments and analytics taken from the following courses: "Databases"- led by Prof. Orozova at the Burgas Free University, Burgas, Bulgaria, and "College Mathematics"-Prof. Hristova at Valencia College, Orlando, Florida, United States of America.

articleTitle: Determination of Tuning parameters of SVC Controllers Using D-decomposition Method
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Recently, for the purpose of voltage stability and increasing the power systems stability in high voltage networks, thyristors-based static Var compensators (SVC) are widely used. The delay time occurred after the switching of the thyristors when used in electric networks characterized by small short circuit currents may lead to violation of the system stability when the parameters of the SVC controller are not correctly tuned. Therefore, the application of such devices should be combined with the developments of methods for determining the tuning parameters of the SVC controllers to ensure their stability. In this paper, on the example of the SVC model with a proportional type controller, it is shown that using the D-decomposition method is one of the possible methods for solving this problem. The application of the proposed D-decomposition method allows constructing the stability zones in the coordinates of the tuning parameters of the SVC controller. To check the stability of the proposed zone, it is proposed to use Nyquist’s criterion.

articleTitle: Dynamic Model of Electro-Hydraulic Pumping Unit Driven by an Asynchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper presents a model of an electrohydraulic pumping unit driven by a three phase asynchronous motor. The model is presented in its form for reversible variable displacement pump and also in a form for fixed displacement pump. Dynamic simulation and analysis of the model is conducted. The obtained results infer that the model of the electro-hydraulic pumping unit is consistent and reliable.

articleTitle: Particle Swarm Optimization Implementation on PMSM Design
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Nowadays most of design changes in electrical machines are made by applying many different design algorithms to reach the best operating point. In this paper particle swarm optimization (PSO) is used for optimization of a permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM). Finite element method (FEM) is preferred for the numerical solution to validate the optimization results. The numerical results of the reference motor and optimized motor are compared in terms of the efficiency and other performance indicators. The improvements are achieved for the optimized motor with the same motor requirements.

articleTitle: Design, Realization and Study of Thermoelectric Watch
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: About 80 % of the energy of the human body is emitted as heat. A person at rest emits about 100 ÷ 120 W. The article explores the possibility of converting the human body heat into electricity. A thermoelectric generator is created based on a Peltier element that is used to power an electronic watch. The realized thermoelectric system generates electrical power, directly proportional to the temperature difference between the human body and the air, and can be used to power low-power electronic devices.

articleTitle: Capabilities for Diagnostics of Pump System's Electrical Equipment via Frequency Converters
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper examines the possibilities of performing diagnostic tests on the induction motors using frequency converters. The methods and algorithms for the implementation of the diagnostic functions of frequency converters are presented. Some practical cases from the exploitation of frequency converters in pump systems are shown to demonstrate their diagnostic capabilities.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Traffic Prioritisation Algorithms in 6LOWPAN Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The worldwide use of Internet of Things (IoT) in recent years requires maintaining a high quality of service (QoS) that achieved by prioritising traffic. There are various prioritisation algorithms to improve the efficiency of sensor networks. In order to determine the best possible algorithm for prioritising traffic a comparative analysis needed. This paper presents a comparative evaluation of author's algorithm for prioritisation of traffic in 6LoWPAN network with five other.

articleTitle: Study of a Linear Generator, Converting Sea Wave Energy into Electricity
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents a study of the influence on the electrical parameters of a linear generator with permanent magnets and no iron core, exerted by the number of its windings, connected in series, the number of their turns and the dimensions of the air gap between the magnets and the windings. Program simulations with ANSYS 2019 R1 and FEMM 4.2 have been performed and experimental studies of the linear generator have been carried out. The obtained model with good accuracy simulates the operation of the studied generator. When the construction is optimized, the electrical parameters of the generator significantly improve.

articleTitle: Approach to Control of a Polarized Reed Switch Using an Equivalent Solenoid Method
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The article presents and discusses possibility of use an equivalent solenoid method to estimate control magnetic field of a polarized reed switch. Simulations were performed for the reed switch controlled by an energizing coil. Applicability of this approach was verified by test results for a physical model of the reed switch.

Author Keywords: polarized switch with magnetically driven contacts

articleTitle: Smart Multisensor Node for Remote Elevator Condition Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The design and implementation of an intelligent multi-sensor module for remote monitoring of the status of elevators are presented herein. The sensor module is an autonomous device that allows the existing lift systems to be efficiently modernized in terms of monitoring their status. The sensor unit monitors the position of the elevator using an inertial navigation system in combination with a barometric altimeter. The evaluation of the performance of the lift system and its technical condition is performed by calculating the basic parameters of the quality of movement, defined by the ISO 187381 standard. The vibration spectrum, the vibration spectrum relative to the position, sound pressure, and lighting levels in the elevator cabin are calculated.

articleTitle: Study of Li-Fi Indoor Network Reliability
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The increasing number of mobile devices and new technologies that uses Internet of Things requires a new ways of fast and secure data transmitting. The Li-Fi technology is one of the solutions to the problem with the small radio frequency bandwidth using the visible light spectrum to transmit data. The handover realization in Li-Fi networks is very important for increasing the reliability of the network and transmitting all the data before leaving the network. This paper presents a study of Li-Fi indoor network and it's reliability and the ability to properly transmit data for the needs of Internet of Things era.

articleTitle: 3-D SAR Geometry and LFM Waveform for Ship Target Imaging
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Three-dimensional (3-D) geometry and Linear Frequency Modulated (LFM) waveform used in Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) signal formation and imaging are in the focus of the present work. A 3-D target's reflectivity function that describes the shape or image of the target is defined. An image reconstruction algorithm including two Fourier transforms and phase correction procedure is created. The phase correction function is presented by a polynomial of second order. To evaluate the quality of the reconstructed SAR image an entropy function is used. To prove the correctness of SAR geometry, kinematics of ship target, LFM SAR signal model, and image reconstruction algorithm simulation experiments are carried out.

Author Keywords: LFM SAR signal model SAR image reconstruction

articleTitle: Coupled Mechanical-Electric Analysis of Hemi-Spherical Bodies in Hertzian Contact
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents stationary coupled mechanical-electric numerical analysis of mechanical pressure, local deformation and current-density distributions in the contact between two hemi-spherical bodies. The analysis is based on a 2D axisymmetric FEM model of two hemi-spherical bodies in Hertzian contact. The proposed model is in compliance with the theoretical calculations and could be used effectively when solving for the contact area radius and penetration, as well as for the distribution of contact pressure, stress and current density.

articleTitle: Research of Reliability of Power Semiconductors in Dependence of Thermal Modes
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Research of reliability of power semiconductors depends on type of semiconductor, electrical modes, quality and number of elements, environment condition of operating arias and thermal modes. Thermal modes impact on reliability of power semiconductors with increasing the junction temperature and this increase correction coefficient by thermal modes. Junction temperature of power semiconductors depends of ambient temperature, power losses in semiconductor and equivalent thermal resistance form junction to ambient. Failure rates of electronic component may be vary with a different power losses and a different temperature of cooling system. This lead to changes of reliability of power semiconductors and in this paper will be research this dependence.

articleTitle: Study of "MI Electric Scooter Pro" Capabilities
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This article aims to experimentally study the capabilities of Mi Electric Scooter Pro. In order to do this experiments have been performed to determine the energy required to accelerate to maximum speed in the three operating modes, as well as the energy returned by regenerative brake. The power required to maintain maximum speed for each of the operating modes at 0 degree inclination is also checked. The experiments were conducted with 65 kg payload. Estimated energy consumption is calculated with this payload at 0 degrees inclination in the three modes for different distances to determine which of the modes is the most effective in terms of energy savings. The maximum speed under these conditions for each mode is shown graphically. The acceleration of starting and stopping is also calculated. Charts for acceleration time to maximum speed and braking time only with regenerative brake are provided. Experiments to determine the impact on energy consumption and speed, depending of payload are also published.

articleTitle: Acquisition and Processing of Navigation Parameters
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This work presents an approach of orientation in terms of geographical coordinates to a system of interest. It is performed by the application of acquisition algorithm of positioning message provided by the global positioning system. The aim is to implement an approach to extract the appropriate navigation parameters out of the navigation message and specify geographic system design to apply this approach. It is verified by the field experiments carried out in the area of port Burgas. The present paper is an extension of the published work on design and implementation of a monitoring system.

articleTitle: Experimental Validating of Reliability Model of MOSFETs in Resonant Full Bridge Inverter
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper concerns a comparison between experimental results and theoretical model of MOSFETs reliability in resonant full bridge inverter. The experimental data is obtained with five different resonant load circuits. The experimental and theoretical results are presented in tabular and graphical form as well. Also some thermal images of the power circuit of the inverter in studied cases are shown.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of Transient Processes in the Electric Pump Block with Throttle Control
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this report are presented and analyzed experimental data on transient processes in the electric pump unit comprising of an external gear pump driven by a threephase asynchronous electric motor. The throttle load control of the electric pump unit is realized and the basic parameters of energy-conversion processes are registered in dynamics, respectively, motor, gear pump and heat load on the oil tank. A thorough analysis of the processes was conducted and important practical conclusions were drawn.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Traffic Prioritisation Algorithms by LTE Base Station Scheduler
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The widespread use of mobile wireless networks require improved quality of service. This paper presents research on influence of different algorithms for prioritising traffic on LTE mobile network. The research bases on results for throughput, delay, packet delivery ratio and packet loss ratio. The comparison between the studied algorithms for traffic prioritisation is done according to the results obtain.

articleTitle: Wideband Signal Detection with Software DSP Processor Implemented on a Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The results of testing a module for detecting a broadband hydroacoustic signal in a given frequency band are presented. The analog part of the module includes a microphone (hydrophone) with a preamplifier and a bandpass filter. The digital part of the module is implemented on a microcontroller designed to digitize the analog hydroacoustic signal and run the software for time processing, and recording the detected signal. The signal is digitized at up to 70 kHz at 12 bit resolution. Detection is performed by averaging the signal strength in a sliding window and comparing the values obtained with a dynamically changing threshold. The dynamic threshold is obtained on the basis of previous statistics of the momentary values of the signal power, averaging them in the window of the selected length, and multiplying them by a coefficient taking into account the level of false alarm. Detection is fixed when the signal level in the current window exceeds the level of the dynamic threshold.

articleTitle: Acoustic Barrier with Energy Harvesting
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The present article introduces a new type of piezoelectric barrier with energy harvesting elements. After modelling the noise barriers with COMSOL and conducting experiments, the location of the piezo elements for energy harvesting was determined. The purpose of this article is to test the efficiency optimization of the energy harvesting at noise reduction. The influence of three different typical types of acoustic spectra and different sound pressure levels on the generated electric energy were determined, as well as the efficiency of the acoustic noise power generation system at three different spectra and at different acoustic noise pressure levels on the acoustic barrier.

articleTitle: Comparsion of Different Methods for Controlling DC-DC Converters in Constant Current Mode
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper compares different control methods for DC-DC converters operating in constant current mode. The following are considered: a classic controller based on a PID controller, a neural network controller, a predictive controller model, and a linearized controller. Controller synthesis was performed based on a model in the MATLAB/Simulink environment. The purpose of the research is to place the controllers under the same destabilizing factors and to evaluate their performance. The results presented here are from a study of a Buck DC-DC converter, but they can also be interpreted for the entire class of devices. On the other hand, they are also useful in Power Electronics training, and especially in the control of power electronic devices and systems.

articleTitle: The Methodology of High-Voltage Instrument Transformers Technical State Index Assessment
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper presents a methodology for technical state assessment of high-voltage instrument current and voltage transformers based on the basic requirements, imposed by governmental regulations. At present, in Russia the methodology of technical state assessment is implemented only for the main technological equipment, among which only the power transformers are considered among 110 kV outdoor equipment. The initial dataset for the presented study was composed of technical diagnostic results and testing data of 110 kV instrument transformers, installed at the outdoor switchgear of thermal power plant. The developed methodology includes the analysis of the power equipment structure, allocation of sub-systems, evaluation criteria and a list of essential parameters, technical state assessment methodology, list of the boundary values, formulation of standard recommendations corresponding to different values of technical state index. The presented approach is validated by providing technical state index calculation results along with failure statistics analysis of the regional power system.

articleTitle: Dynamic Performance Analysis of an Iron-cored Winding at AC Mode of Operation
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Investigation results are presented for determination of the dynamic thermal response of an iron-cored winding under AC mode of operation. Both power losses Pw in the copper coil volume and Pc in the ferromagnetic core volume are considered for a 2-RC elements thermal equivalent scheme. Attention is specially focused on the role of the thermal resistance between the winding and the core. Solution for the circuit dynamic thermal response is presented together with the corresponding expressions for the existing in the solution constants. Results are compared with a sample experimental data-for a transformer winding incorporated within a standard core EI 120×40.

articleTitle: Simulation Training Models for an Automatic Transfer Switch and Relay Protection
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper presents simulation training models for visualizing the processes in electricity systems. For electrical medium voltage networks, voltages and currents are visualized to study the behavior of relay protection, automatic reconnection, and user backup in Matlab Simulink environments. Standard and custom developed library blocks are used, with user-defined definition. The created blocks allow to get acquainted with the standard functionalities of modern relay protection. An opportunity to improve the quality of education through computer visualization is presented.

articleTitle: Photometric Flicker of LED Luminaires According to Driver Type
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper presents investigation of flicker introduced by industrial LED luminaires at wide range of different driving currents and fed by different driving devices. Except for the photometric flicker, electrical parameters of the luminaire before and after the driver are monitored in order to obtain dependency between them.

articleTitle: Corner Capacitance of Narrow Strip in Rectangular Cross Section Envelope
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The 2D capacitance of a thin (zero thickness) strip in the center of rectangular cross section envelope can be evaluated using the formulas for 2D "corner" geometric capacitances or permeances. If the width of the strip is larger than the height of the envelope the known corner capacitance for infinitely wide strip can be used, In the paper, using conformal mapping with special functions and numerical conformal mapping, more exact approximate formulas than existing. are proposed for the case of narrow strip, with the width smaller than envelope height.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of Battery Storage Installed in Photovoltaic Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper proposes a mathematical multilinear regression battery model in photovoltaic (PV) power plant. The model uses the battery current and the state of charge as independent variables. The mathematical model is implemented and realized in Matlab environment. To validate and analyze the model adequacy and accuracy a comparative analysis with battery installed in PV power plant operating in real life conditions is made. The results show admissible accuracy combined with high computational efficiency. Extensive options for additional improvement and model fine tuning are present.

articleTitle: Real-Time LQG Control Strategies for Electrohydraulic Steering of Mobile Machines
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The main aim of the article is to compare two real-time control strategies for electrohydraulic power steering system of modern mobile machines with Linear-quadratic Gaussian (LQG) controllers. The both modification of LQG controller are designed on the basis of two multivariable uncertain plant models. The plant models are obtained by identification procedure via "black box" approach and takes into account the deviations of the parameters that characterize the way that the control signal acts on the state of the models. The difference between the two modifications of the embedded controllers lies in the different types of output signals, which are used as feedback in control system. The comparative analysis of time and frequency domain properties of controllers are performed. The results obtained show the better performance of one system. The control algorithms are implemented in 32-bit microcontroller. A number of experiments have been executed, which confirm the quality of the electrohydraulic power steering control system.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling of a Heat Exchanger by the Wavelet Function Method
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The purpose of the study is to determine the mathematical model of a heat exchanger from an ammonia production plant. Various classes of wavelet functions are used to identify the parameters and their influence on the adequacy of the model is investigated. Relative parameter errors and relative output errors are used to compare the results.

articleTitle: The Influence of Supply Voltage Phase Angle on the Transient Current Generated on Transformer Energization
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents a method of predetermining the transient current generated during transformer energization, in order to adopt optimal solutions to prevent the failure situations. Due to the shock produced by this transient current in transformer windings, and, given the fact that its magnitude is dependent on the moment of the transformer energization, i.e. on the value of the phase angle of the supply voltage, for the purpose of current attenuation simulations were carried out to determine the optimum connection angle. The method was applied to a 15 MVA, 10.5 / 6.3 kV power transformer, with Δ/Δ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> connection, and the results obtained were validated by laboratory tests.

articleTitle: Software for Data Cleaning and Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Since the appearance of Data Mining concept until the era of Big Data, the change in size of analyzed data, the arise of high performance systems, new technologies and software programs. Data science emerge as a field, which combines many approaches and techniques, related to data analyzing, process of data cleaning, integration of data, selection and transformation, knowledge extraction, evaluation and representation. The report outlines the main problems the authors encountered in cleaning up the data before analyzing it and proposes new SCSV software (scala comma separated values). Experiments have been conducted to clean up and analyze large volumes of data, based on machine learning techniques, from annual surveys among StackOverflow users.

articleTitle: Practical Approach for Psophometric Noise Measurement in DC/DC Converters
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In the current paper the term psophometric noise refers to audible ripple in the output of DC/DC converters and more specifically in DC/DC converters part of the output stages of telecom rectifiers. Although psophometric noise in telecom rectifiers is a dated parameter, it still remains as a set value in standards and device specifications, making it a requirement for marketable products. Therefore, the paper suggests a practical approach for measurement of psophometric noise. The approach utilizes easily available measurement devices with logging capability and external computer based digital processing in order to evaluate the noise. This allows for a simplified and accessible solution that can be used during design and prototyping stages, negating the need of acquiring specialized psophometric meters. The suggested approach offers relatively high accuracy - depending on the input device, and complies with some of the recommendation for standardized psophometric noise measurement.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Application for the High-Voltage Equipment Lifecycle Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents the model of the intelligent lifecycle management system for high-voltage power network equipment. The model is validated by providing technical state estimates for 110 kV oil-filled power transformers based on the technical diagnostic data retrospective. The transformers are operated at the substations of the regional power system. The problem of assessing the power equipment technical state is addressed from the point of view of mathematics as a classification problem, while the problem of technical state prediction is considered as a regression task. In the framework of the author's research, the adaptive system for managing and forecasting of the power equipment lifecycle based on machine learning methods was developed, where gradient boosting over decision trees is used as the core mathematical algorithm for solving the above problems: both for classification and regression ones.

articleTitle: Wire Grounding Electrode near Vertical Cylindrical Non-homogeneity
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Satisfactorily accurate approximation of soil inhomogeneity providing simple determination of the soil structure influence on grounding system characteristics is important part of the procedure for grounding system analysis. Very often, ground non-homogeneity can be approximated as vertical cylinder tube (wells, various tubes, pillar foundation etc.). The method based on using of Method on Moments and Green's function, applicable for analysis of grounding systems placed in the surrounding soil of this type non-homogeneity is presented in the paper.

articleTitle: Distributed Public Cloud on Low Power Devices
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The current cloud providers run their cloud platforms on big private data centers with huge power demands and resource consumptions. This paper presents a model for a distributed, free, public cloud on low power devices. The main idea is to use peoples home low power devices and their resources to build a free distributed cloud platform. The attempt has been made to use existing open source technologies. The research will allow building public distributed cloud platforms offering different services like storage, computation etc. as an alternative to the proprietary cloud platforms running on huge powerful centralized private data centers.

articleTitle: Forecasting Energy Efficiency and Energy Consumption in Bulgaria by Examining the Energy Intensity Indicator Using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The energy policy of a country is crucial to the prosperity of its economy. There are many factors to consider - dependence on imports, diversification of energy sources, increasing global energy demand, energy efficiency, climate impact, etc. Effective energy planning is based on the estimated energy consumption and the energy efficiency of the economy. The article presents the results of researches conducted for these two indicators, the subject of the study being the energy system of the Republic of Bulgaria. Mathematical models are presented for forecasting the energy intensity of the economy by studying the trend model with time series and through artificial neural networks. A neural network model for predicting the final energy consumption has also been developed, based on data on the gross domestic product and the energy intensity of the economy.

articleTitle: Comparison of Electromagnetic Formulations for Multilayer HTS Power Cable Modeling
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Second generation of superconducting power cables is well suited for the increasing demand of higher power densities. In this paper two different architectures of high-temperature superconducting (HTS) power cables are investigated under AC conditions. Comparison of electromagnetic 2D (A-V) and 3D (T-Ω) finite element method formulations is made. For models implementation ANSYS Maxwell solvers has been used. The mutual- and self-inductances are calculated in order to estimate the expected AC inductive impedance of HTS power cable architectures. Results accuracy comparison and discussion on formulations benefits are presented.

articleTitle: Mid-term Adequacy Assessment of Bulgarian Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This report is prepared as a mid-term adequacy assessment of Bulgarian power supply during the transition period 2020-2030. The main purpose is to detect the most suitable low-carbon technologies from technical point of view and the required magnitude of their future penetration, in order to replace existing polluting lignite generation, but also to preserve the adequacy of the supply.

articleTitle: Radon Concentration Gauge
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: We present a gauge for dynamic monitoring of radon concentration in Bq/m3, designed and manufactured in-house. The device is equipped with additional sensors for measuring background beta+gamma and gamma radiation, as well as CO2 levels. The measurement results are reported every 600 seconds. The device is part of a growing network aiming to monitor and report radon level dynamics in real time. The data is collected on a server and is freely accessible under CC0 licence (public domain).

articleTitle: Investigation of the Electrical and Photometric Parameters of Industrial LED Luminaire Fed by Different Drivers
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper presents detailed investigation of the electrical parameters of an industrial LED Luminaire, 220W, fed with four different drivers, in terms of waveforms of current and voltage, harmonic analysis of the current and voltage, power - active, reactive and apparent and power factor. The photometric parameters considered are the chromaticity coordinates of the emitted light; the correlated color temperature, the general color rendering index and the color fidelity index used for genuine description of the color of light, the dominant wavelength and the dominant wavelength. The drivers taken in consideration allow dimming of the luminous flux of the LED luminaire, so the electrical and photometric parameters are also measured and compared for different dimming levels.

articleTitle: Methodology for Investigation of Supercapacitor Equivalent Distributed Resistance in Pulse Modes
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: the publication examines the behavior of supercapacitors when discharging with high pulse currents with a duration of less than 10ms. The declared values of supercapacitor electrical parameters from the manufacturers cannot be applied and are not valid in the tested pulse modes. The study presents the behavior of a supercapacitor when a pulsed current flows through it by estimating the equivalent distributed resistance parameter - EDR. A method for its experimental determination by using a current pulse with a strictly linear leading edge and a constant plateau is proposed. Results from the application of the methodology are presented in the current paper.

articleTitle: Theoretical and Experimental Study of Drum Electromagnetic Separator for Waste Material
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Owing to its numerous advantages, magnet drum separator finds wide application in industry nowadays. This raises some questions related to the theoretical and practical applications of these methods of magnet field treatment. In order that the quality and effectiveness of their application be enhanced, the existing methods of research and improvement of the constructive solutions need to be made preciser. The solution of the above questions requires application of new mathematical models and computer methods of research. In this paper research the device of electromagnetic drum separator for waste material. The described mathematical model has been realized by the method of finite elements. In support to the theoretical research, an experiment has also been conducted in order to assess the adequacy of the model.

articleTitle: A Power Loss Analysis of a Three-Phase 12/8 Switched Reluctance Motor Fed from Asymmetric Power Converter in MATLAB/SIMULINK
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The present paper studies the influence of the different factors (motor speed, turn-on and turn-off SRM switching angles, etc.) on conduction and switching losses in the power converter fed three-phase 12/8 SRM. The analytical methods in use are compared to the simulation results in a MATLAB/SIMULINK environment.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Change of the Single Line to Earth Fault Current in Medium Voltage Electrical Grids Grounded Through an Active Resistance
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper investigates the change of the earth fault current in medium voltage electrical grids grounded through an active resistance. Grids with different percentages of cable lengths are considered. For the purpose of the study, simulations of medium voltage electrical grid were made. The maximum value of the currents in transient mode and the duration of the process, the magnitude of the current of a single line to ground fault in the steady state mode with the change of transient resistance and the location of the fault are investigated.

Author Keywords: single line to earth fault current

articleTitle: Sensorless Control of PMSM using FOC Strategy Based on PI-ILC Law and Sliding Mode Observer
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: It is a well-known fact that, if a control system must perform repetitive tasks, it is advisable to use an Iterative Learning Control (ILC). Considering that there are many cases where the tasks which must be performed by the control structure of a Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM) are repetitive, and the load torque has an oscillating character, this article presents the control structures, the equations and the mathematical modeling for a PI-ILC control system, in which the learning factor α is adaptive, in order to achieve superior performance. A Sliding Mode Observer (SMO) is used in the control system implemented in Matlab/Simulink, which improves the performance in terms of the reliability of the control system. It also presents the directions for the follow-up on the study regarding the control systems and the observers for the PMSM and the real-time implementation.

articleTitle: Modelling and Examining the Dynamic Characteristics of an Electro-Hydraulic Unit for Discrete Control Based on Direct Acting High-Speed Servo Valve
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper presents and examines the possible application of discrete control method to hydraulic actuators. A dynamic model of the electro-hydraulic unit for discrete control is proposed as a main component in such power system. This unit consists of connecting pipe, small volume accumulator and a direct acting high-speed servo valve. The dynamic behavior of the unit is examined in the time domain. The obtained numerical results infer the practical significance of such control method.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm for Optimized Design of Flyback Transformers
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper presents an approach into designing transformers for flyback converters. The approach is based on the concept of computer aided design, where at its core is the utilization of a genetic algorithm. The genetic algorithm allows for optimal selection of critical transformer components and parameters, where the objective function - based on user preference - may include efficiency, cost, geometric size, thermal dissipation, weight and other parameters critical to the design. Each step of the design approach is presented and explained in details. The algorithm is realized and integrated into a computer application. The approach and the developed application are verified over a test design, where a selected example is presented in detail in order to highlight each step of the algorithm. The approach allows for the development of optimal designs over several algorithm generations.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of the Influence of Some Parameters on the Characteristics of Hybrid Electromagnetic System with Magnetic Flux Modulation
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Experimental study of a prototype of hybrid electromagnetic system with magnetic flux modulation is carried out with specially assembled control and measurement circuits. Also, software algorithm and computer graphical interface for controlling of the system and for visualisation of the achieved results have been developed. Results are obtained for the current through the coils and for the changes of the magnetic flux. Two different measurement sensors are used in order to verify the accuracy of the results for the current through the coils.

articleTitle: Determination of the Energy Efficiency of Domestic Electric Cooktops in Real Operating Conditions
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Over the past years, energy efficiency has become a current issue of great concern in all sphere of industry and household sector. This paper presents a methodology for assessment of the energy efficiency of household electric cooktops, while taking into account the impact of various operating factors and measures to improve it. The results obtained and the conclusions drawn show that the use of modern domestic hobs improves energy efficiency. The development of adequate models for evaluation of the influence of the exploitation and design factors on the energy efficiency of electric hot plates (EHP) will enable the achievement, with ecodesign of these appliances, of maxumum boundary values of energy consumption in energy-related products, as set in the draft of the EU Regulation for implementation of Directive 2009/125/EC, and will also ensure that adequate measures are taken to improve the energy-efficiency services in this sector as per BS EN 15900.

articleTitle: A Parametric Study of an Electrothermal Oscillator Based on Shape Memory Alloys
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper presents a parametric study of an electrothermal oscillator based on Shape Memory Alloy. The operating principle of the oscillator is established on a heated by electric current Shape Memory Alloy wire, mounted with a pre-tension between the free ends of two symmetrically placed cantilever beams. The effect of crystallographic changes in the wire due to heating leads to the generation of mechanical and electrical vibrations. Parametric studies were conducted to investigate the influence of the input parameters on the system output characteristics.

articleTitle: The finite element model and analyses of a three-phase 12/8 pole Switched Reluctance Motor
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper presents simulation model, realized by the finite element method of a three-phase 12/8 switched reluctance motor (SRM) in the software simulator Infolytica MotorSolve. The highly non-linear characteristics of this type of motor complicate the analytical methods for the analysis. For this reason, the numerical method (FEA) is used to obtain accurate characteristics of the basic parameters of the motor. The physical dimensions of the machine are used to obtain the model. On the basis of the FEA model, the characteristics of a phase inductance, a torque and a flux-linkage are obtained, which are the main characteristics of SRM, and have a significant impact on the operation of the motor. The obtained simulation results for the different characteristics of the SRM are determined at different positions of the rotor and excitation currents of the phase windings.

articleTitle: Pseudo 3-D ISAR Imaging by Barker’s Phase Code Modulated Waveforms
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: A three-dimensional geometrical model of inverse synthetic aperture radar (ISAR), and a model of Barker's phase code modulation (BPCM) signal are suggested. A spatial correlation with a known reference function is applied to extract a target's pseudo-3-D image from 2-D ISAR data. To prove the correctness of the geometry, signal model, and imaging algorithm a numerical experiment is carried out.

articleTitle: Determination of the Optimal Circuit-Engineering Solution of Electronic Circuits
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The wide range of differences in conditions (temperature, pressure, humidity, vibrations, radiation) for communication equipment leads to hard demands towards the tolerances of the input parameters of the compound electronics circuits. The mentioned demands in case of electronic circuits are maintained with reducing of the tolerances of the functional elements mainly and using of new technical solution, which to give minimum influence of the destabilizing factors. The second method is much more perspective. In such a case this way gives an manual for establishing of an optimum technical decision for designing of communication equipment and an example how to use it.

articleTitle: PSS/E Based Power System Stabilizer Tuning Tool
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Since their introduction, Power System Stabilizers have become widely accepted as an efficient supplementary excitation controller for extending the power transfer capability limits of the system by adding damping to the low-frequency electromechanical modes of oscillation to improve the overall system stability. The purpose of the tool presented in this paper is to enable an easy to use, flexible and accurate tuning of various types of Power System Stabilizers, both for a SMIB, as well as multi-machine system configurations. The tool is built in Python and relies on the dynamic models of the PSS/E library, and the PSS/E steady-state and dynamic simulation modules. The key component of this new tool is PSS/E's linearization module, which generates the linear state-space model around a steady-state operating point of the full non-linear dynamic model of the system. It provides valuable tools necessary for the analysis of the stability phenomena and tackling with the optimization of the stabilizer parameters and validation of the results. The core features of the tool were demonstrated with the well-established Kundur's four-machine test system. Utilizing interpreted language, such as Python, makes it very convenient for potential users to flexibly create custom scripts to perform the analysis and optimization according to their needs and preferences.

articleTitle: An Approach for Investigation of the Temperature Field in a Three-Phase Asynchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This article considers an approach for investigation of the temperature field of an asynchronous motor by use of a test bench and a model based on the finite element method. The experiments have been performed under different operating modes and at different power supply frequencies. Based on the results obtained, the adequacy of the model has been evaluated.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy Control of Peltier-Based Thermal Chamber for Reliability Tests
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This article studies possibilities of applying some artificial intellect techniques to control the thermal cycling modes of a thermal chamber for reliability tests. Peltier elements are used to be achieved consecutive heating/cooling cycles. A fuzzy logic approach is applied to control the temperature inside the chamber according to previous given requirements.

articleTitle: AIS Assisted Sentinel-1 SLC Image Ship Detection, Motion and Displacement Estimation
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In the paper an algorithm for complex synthetic aperture radar (SAR) ship images, automatic identification system (AIS) assisted detection and motion estimation is proposed. Displacement of the moving target on the SAR image is calculated by formula and compared with that measured from AIS data or ship wake.

articleTitle: Modeling and Development of Position Sensors Based on Multiferroic Layered Structures
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper is devoted to modeling and development of position sensors based on multiferroic layered structures. The multiferroic layered structures is made from a bidomain lithium niobate single crystal with a Y + 128° cut and amorphous metal of Metglas. The value of ME resonant voltage coefficient was of 920 V/(cm·Oe). ME multiferroic sensors can successfully competition with induction sensors and Hall effect sensors used in the modern automotive industry. Increasing the sensitivity of ME multiferroic sensors is an relevant task, the solution of which will significantly improve the parameters of the proposed sensors, for example, reduce weight and dimensions, and increase reliability.

articleTitle: Software Tool for Evaluation of Traffic Prioritisation Algorithms in 6LOWPAN Network
publicationTitle: 2020 21st International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus & Technologies (SIELA)
